nativePageUrl.description: Exact Cells native page entry URL (DD-127 native page entry); its origin must be one of the release nativePageOrigins and the deployment NATIVE_PAGE_ORIGINS.

directoryClientId.description: DD-133(4), .design/07 §4.7.4: the IdP client id of this component instance's own confidential directory client. Core accepts a member directory read only from a client-credentials token whose azp equals it; it must be unique among non-DISABLED bindings and differ from any adapter client_id. Core never creates or holds this client's credential.
